name: io.github.MakeMyClip/editor
title: MakeMyClip Editor
description: Local video editor: cut silence, edit by transcript, add captions, export to Final Cut or Premiere.

environmentVariables.name: MAKEMYCLIP_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Folder the editor may read and write; put your videos here. Defaults to a folder in the temp directory.

environmentVariables.name: MAKEMYCLIP_WHISPER_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: a whisper.cpp model file (e.g. ggml-base.en.bin) for transcripts and captions.

environmentVariables.name: MAKEMYCLIP_FFMPEG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional: an FFmpeg to use instead of the one ffmpeg-static downloads.

environmentVariables.name: MAKEMYCLIP_WHISPER_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional: the whisper-cli binary, when it isn't on PATH.
